og_title: The Moment Ji Ning Gets His Hands on 'Three Heads, Six Arms'!
og_description: Ji Ning secures a legendary divine ability from Celestial Immortal Wujiang's secret vault. His power is about to skyrocket.
twitter_title: Ji Ning finally gets 'Three Heads, Six Arms'!
twitter_description: Loot jackpot! Ji Ning finds the top-tier divine abilities in the secret vault. The 'Starseizing Hand' combo is coming.

lore_anchors.definition: The rank of a fully-realized immortal who has transcended the Five Elements. In this chapter, a legacy left by one is considered the pinnacle of power.
A legendary, top-tier divine ability in the Three Realms, often associated with Buddha forms in mythology, granting supreme invulnerability.
A simplified version of the 'Eight-Foot Adamantine Body' that uses five different types of lightning to forge an indestructible body.
A rare type of magical technique that weaponizes a cultivator's spiritual perception (divine sense) for mental attacks and defenses.
A divine sense secret art found by Ji Ning, allowing a cultivator to manifest soldiers with a single thought.
A spatial movement ability where a cultivator teleports from one location to another in an instant.
The central library of the immortal estate, housing the complete collection of techniques, secret arts, and divine abilities.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is 'Three Heads, Six Arms' so powerful for Ji Ning?
cultural_notes_faq.a: 'Three Heads, Six Arms' creates real, functional arms. This means all six of Ji Ning's hands can simultaneously use the 'Starseizing Hand' divine ability, multiplying his offensive power by six.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the 'Five Thunder Adamantine Body' considered a simplified technique?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The text states the creator simplified the legendary, Buddha-level 'Eight-Foot Adamantine Body' to make it accessible to powerful Fiendgod Body Refiners, requiring five lightning baptisms instead of the original's divine level.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Ji Ning want anyone to know about his discovery?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the Yuchi clan was completely annihilated by greedy cultivators for possessing the 'Windwing Evasion' technique. Showing off rare divine abilities is a sure way to invite deadly trouble.
